about: Every agent of Indi's, and when each one wakes up on its own. Times are UTC, which is the same as Lisbon and London time in November. Kept by conductor@web-summit.indi from the scheduled tasks in Indi's Claude account (checked 8 November 2026, 07:25 UTC) and people/indi/agents.json.

each: Reads what changed on the team site
Reads your mentor's and helpers' notes
Keeps your folder and roster up to date
Adds your items to the stand-up
reads: Your kit and the agents page
